_scene.caption: A plan being composed, driven through the composer's own buttons: two burns seeded at instants the craft can still act on
_scene.unchangedWhenStale: Every figure in a draft being composed is the operator's own input, burn instants, components and their total, held in the command centre rather than read off the stream. The send window of a saved plan is the figure measured against telemetry, and it is marked held.
